mapper.sql: job_id, job_kind, run_id, work_item_id, group_id, member_seq, member_identity, tool_call_id, tool_name, external_operation_id, state, request_json::text AS request_json, task_id, reservation_json::text AS reservation_json, result_ref_json::text AS result_ref_json, schema_version, owner_instance_id, lease_expires_at, claim_epoch, next_poll_at, poll_count, backoff_step, stop_state, stop_attempt_count, stop_last_error, timeout_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_async_tool_task ( job_kind, run_id, work_item_id, group_id, member_seq, member_identity, tool_call_id, tool_name, external_operation_id, state, request_json, task_id, reservation_json, result_ref_json, schema_version, owner_instance_id, lease_expires_at, claim_epoch, next_poll_at, poll_count, backoff_step, stop_state, stop_attempt_count, stop_last_error, timeout_at, finished_at ) VALUES ( #{jobKind}, #{runId}, #{workItemId}, #{groupId}, #{memberSeq}, #{memberIdentity}, #{toolCallId}, #{toolName}, #{externalOperationId}, #{state}, #{requestJson}::jsonb, #{taskId}, #{reservationJson}::jsonb, #{resultRefJson}::jsonb, #{schemaVersion}, #{ownerInstanceId}, #{leaseExpiresAt}, #{claimEpoch}, #{nextPollAt}, #{pollCount}, #{backoffStep}, #{stopState}, #{stopAttemptCount}, #{stopLastError}, #{timeoutAt}, #{finishedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_async_tool_task SET owner_instance_id = #{owner}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseUntil}, claim_epoch = claim_epoch + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= #{now})

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_async_tool_task SET task_id = #{taskId}, state = 'RUNNING', next_poll_at = #{nextPollAt}, timeout_at = #{timeoutAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE external_operation_id = #{operationId} AND state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_async_tool_task SET task_id = #{taskId}, state = 'RUNNING', next_poll_at = #{nextPollAt}, timeout_at = #{timeoutAt}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND claim_epoch = #{claimEpoch} AND state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_async_tool_task SET state = 'CANCELED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, stop_state = 'PENDING', next_poll_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND stop_state IS NULL

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_async_tool_task SET stop_state = 'CLAIMED', owner_instance_id = #{owner}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseUntil}, claim_epoch = claim_epoch + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND stop_state IN ('PENDING', 'CLAIMED') AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= #{now})

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_async_tool_task SET stop_state = 'CONFIRMED', -- 停机确认时把沙箱任务编号写回任务行：取消之后 attach 语句不再命中（它只认待执行/执行中）， -- 不在这里写，收口侧永远看不到「这次停的是哪个作业」。查无作业时保持原值（空）。 task_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskId}::varchar, ''), task_id), stop_last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND claim_epoch = #{claimEpoch} AND stop_state = 'CLAIMED'

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_async_tool_task SET stop_state = 'PENDING', stop_attempt_count = stop_attempt_count + 1, stop_last_error = #{lastError}, next_poll_at = #{nextPollAt}, owner_instance_id = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND claim_epoch = #{claimEpoch} AND stop_state = 'CLAIMED'
